ayahOccurrences.text: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا آخَرِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ ۗ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَفْقَهُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ مِنۢ بَعْدِكُم مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ مِنۢ بَعْدِكُم مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّٰتٍ مَّعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَٱلنَّخْلَ وَٱلزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَٰبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ ۚ كُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَءَاتُوا۟ حَقَّهُۥ يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِۦ ۖ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّٰتٍ مَّعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَٱلنَّخْلَ وَٱلزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَٰبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ ۚ كُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَءَاتُوا۟ حَقَّهُۥ يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِۦ ۖ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنشِئُ ٱلسَّحَابَ ٱلثِّقَالَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ

lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ش/أ   n–sh–ʾ the young, youth, young plants and animals, the young generations, the first hours of the night
; to rise, to grow, to emerge, to come into being, to create, to initiate, to cause to grow, to raise from the dead; to glean information.

Of this root, 7 forms occur 28 times in the Qur’an:
يُنَشَّأُ yunashshaʾ 1 time; أَنْشَأَ ʾanshaʾa 20 times; نَاشِئَةٌ nāshiʾatun 1 time; نَشْأَةٌ nashʾatun 3 times; إِنْشَاءٌʾinshāʾ 1 time; مُنْشِئُون munshiʾūn 1 time and مُنْشَآتٌ munshaʾāt 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أَنْشَأَ ʾanshaʾa [v. IV trans.]

1 to create, to fashion out

(11:61) هُوَ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الأَرْضِ He brought you into being from the earth

2 to initiate, to give rise to

(6:6) وَأَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ and We raised other generations after them

3 to make into, to transfigure, to transmute

(23:14) فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ then we fashioned the lump of flesh into bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, then We transformed him into a different creation/creature

4 to form, to shape, to build up

(13:12) هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنْشِئُ السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ it is He who shows you the lightning, [inspiring] fear and hope and He forms the heavy rainclouds

5 to devise, to make

(23:78) وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالأَبْصَارَ وَالأَفْئِدَةَ it is He who devised for you hearing, sight and hearts

6 to renew, to re‐create

(56:35) إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا We have created them anew, making them virginal, loving and of matching age.

entries.label: ن-ش-أ
entries.definitionHtml:
ن/ش/أ   n–sh–ʾ the young, youth, young plants and animals, the young generations, the first hours of the night
; to rise, to grow, to emerge, to come into being, to create, to initiate, to cause to grow, to raise from the dead; to glean information.

Of this root, 7 forms occur 28 times in the Qur’an:
يُنَشَّأُ yunashshaʾ 1 time; أَنْشَأَ ʾanshaʾa 20 times; نَاشِئَةٌ nāshiʾatun 1 time; نَشْأَةٌ nashʾatun 3 times; إِنْشَاءٌʾinshāʾ 1 time; مُنْشِئُون munshiʾūn 1 time and مُنْشَآتٌ munshaʾāt 1 time.

entries.label: إِنْشَاءٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
إِنْشَاءٌ ʾinshāʾ [v. n.] the act of creating, initiation

(56:35) إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً We have created them anew.

entries.label: مُنْشَآتٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُنْشَآتٌ munshaʾāt [pl. of fem. pass. part. مُنْشَأَة munshaʾatun] constructed, initiated, raised aloft, hoisted up

(55:24) وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنْشَآتُ فِى الْبَحْرِ كَالأَعْلاَمِ among His signs are the ships [lit. the runners of the sea], constructed like floating mountains (or, sailing swiftly, like fluttering flags).

entries.label: مُنْشِئُون
entries.definitionHtml:
مُنْشِئُون munshiʾūn [pl. of act. part. مُنْشِئ munshiʾ] ones who initiate, produce, fashion

(56:72) ءَأَنْتُمْ أَنْشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَا أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنْشِئُونَ is it you who have brought into being the tree [that serves as its fuel] or are We its creators?

entries.label: نَاشِئَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَاشِئَةٌ nāshiʾatun [fem. act. part.] that which appears anew, that which occurs for the first time ِ*

(73:6) نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ variously interpreted as: prayers in the middle of the night, hours of the night spent in prayer, those who spend such hours in prayer, night prayers (or, those who perform such prayers) [lit. that which is initiated at night, such as the hours of the night, or events taking place during the night].

entries.label: نَشْأَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَشْأَةٌ nashʾatun [v. n./unit n.] creation, initiation; a creation

(56:62) وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الأُولَى you have already known the first creation.

entries.label: يُنَشَّأُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُنَشَّأُ yunashshaʾ [imperf. pass. v. II] to be raised, to be brought up, to be reared *

(43:18) مَنْ يُنَشَّأُ فِى الْحِلْيَةِ a little girl [lit. one who is brought up amidst [an abundance of] jewellery].
